mythManifests.name: Operatic Reflection
mythManifests.bonus: Amplifies Lingering Glow & Burn detonation DMG by +35% and inflicts Halo stacks.

mythManifests.name: Star of Misfortune
mythManifests.bonus: Boosts Impromptu Inspiration & Conduit Crit DMG while generating +2 Eureka per round.

mythManifests.name: Mountain Ghost
mythManifests.bonus: Converts allied HP drain into thicker Bloodtithe Pool charges and grants teamwide Leech.

mythManifests.name: Ashen Beast
mythManifests.bonus: Accelerates Pulsing Electric Field to Level 3 and triggers chain electromagnetic follow-ups.

mythManifests.name: Primitive Urge
mythManifests.bonus: Provides teamwide cleanse, Genesis DMG amplification, and +1 Moxie to Slot 1 Carry.

characters.name: Beryl
characters.euphoriaPriority: Native 3.x True Limited Apex — No Euphoria required.
characters.summary: True Limited Lingering Glow hypercarry. Refracts enemy Burn & Glow stacks into multi-hit prismatic beams that ignore 40% Mental DEF.

characters.name: Brume
characters.summary: Core driver of the 'Dynamo Wheelchair' engine. Turns Pulsing Electric Field Lv. 3 into relentless AoE and single-target electromagnetic sweeps.

characters.name: Charon
characters.summary: AP+1 generator, incantation shuffler, and Dynamo battery. Keeps Electric Field permanently at max charge without consuming carry AP.

characters.name: Lorentz Butterfly
characters.summary: Rewrites incantation ranks in hand and multiplies Lingering Glow stack caps by 1.5x while providing massive teamwide DMG Bonus.

characters.name: Rhiannon
characters.summary: Grants Slot-1 Carry an Extra Turn window and massive Crit DMG / Incantation Might, slotting seamlessly into Conduit and hypercarry teams.

characters.name: Flutterpage
characters.euphoriaPriority: Native Extra Action Anchor — P0 Complete.
characters.summary: Converts surplus AP and card movement into Gust Force stacks, remaining the premier Extra Action amplifier across all endgame modes.

characters.name: Enigma
characters.summary: Dedicated Dynamo Bastion sustainer. Automatically cleanses control debuffs, generates Electric Field charge when allies are hit, and grants thick barriers.

characters.name: Marsha
characters.summary: Impenetrable Lingering Glow shielder and cleanser who inflicts passive Burn/Glow on attackers and boosts allied Penetration Rate.

characters.name: The Twins
characters.summary: Dual-stance Star Conduit carry whose single-target strikes echo across all Conduit-linked enemies with 100% splash efficiency.

characters.name: Isolde
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Top Priority — Converts Heat/Burn directly into Lingering Glow).
characters.summary: With her E1 Euphoria awakening, Isolde's Finale state automatically converts excess Burn into Lingering Glow and shreds 35% Reality & Mental DEF.

characters.name: Igor
characters.summary: Heavy Bullet & Ultimate artillery commander who loads Armor-Piercing shells and fires zero-AP Ultimate follow-ups.

characters.name: Nautika
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Essential — Doubles Bloodtithe Pool consumption multiplier).
characters.summary: Flagship Bloodtithe hypercarry. Consumes accumulated team HP loss from the Bloodtithe Pool to unleash screen-clearing Mineral anchors.

characters.name: Semmelweis
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Mandatory for Bloodtithe teams).
characters.summary: Euphoria E1 transforms her Blood Domain Array into the core engine of Bloodtithe, safely draining and refunding allied HP while granting +60% DMG.

characters.name: Barcarola
characters.summary: Conducts the Impromptu Quartet, converting allied Eureka into high-hit Inspiration crescendos at the end of every round.

characters.name: Paper Heron
characters.summary: Deploys the Paper Wing Array, doubling Eureka generation speed and allowing Impromptu hits to bounce an extra 3 times.

characters.name: Ulrich
characters.summary: High-frequency Dynamo sub-carry whose Laplace coil turrets fire automatically whenever the Pulsing Electric Field shifts level.

characters.name: Kiperina
characters.summary: Provides zero-AP Eureka-fueled shields, teamwide cleanse, and +25% Impromptu Crit DMG.

characters.name: Rubuska
characters.euphoriaPriority: Native Slot-4 Bloodtithe Healer — P0 Complete.
characters.summary: Slot-4 specialist healer who prevents fatal damage during deep HP drains and overfills the Bloodtithe Pool every turn.

characters.name: Everecho
characters.summary: Links all 4 allies into a protective Conduit harmony, healing the entire team whenever a linked enemy takes Conduit splash damage.

characters.name: Cornerstone
characters.summary: Fortifies the team with crystalline Mineral bulwarks that convert incoming boss AoE strikes into bonus Dynamo Field charge and Counter Penetration.

characters.name: Hedone
characters.summary: Inflicts permanent Conduit Vulnerability on bosses so single-target Conduit carries can trigger double echo splashes even against solo raid bosses.

characters.name: Coppélia
characters.summary: Mechanical dancer who pirouettes with automatic follow-up strikes every time an allied Conduit link pulses.

characters.name: Fatutu
characters.partners: Jiu Niangzi, Lucy, Windsong [E1], Anjo Nala [E1]
characters.summary: Distributes Spirit Shells that cleanse debuffs on contact, redistribute single-target damage, and buff Extra Action Crit DMG.

characters.name: Recoleta
characters.summary: High-cycling Mineral Ultimate carry who refunds her own Moxie and scales Ultimate Might with every incantation cast.

characters.name: Lucy
characters.euphoriaPriority: True Limited Veteran — Pairs strongly with Charon & Enigma.
characters.summary: Classic Dynamo & Extra Action sweeper who excels in multi-wave Limbo and Reveries stages thanks to her Data Iteration upgrades.

characters.name: Windsong
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Auto-merges Proof of Ley Lines without AP loss).
characters.summary: Euphoria E1 removes her multi-turn ramp penalty, allowing her Ultimate turn to unleash a devastating single-target card barrage.

characters.name: Anjo Nala
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Boosts Contract follow-up frequency).
characters.summary: Binds to an ally to share Afflatus rhythms, firing joint Extra Action attacks and crowd-controlling dangerous Hadal elites.

characters.name: Lopera
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Makes Crucible Bullet Array permanent).
characters.summary: Core Bullet Array buffer who converts excess Crit Rate into Crit DMG while providing passive teamwide healing.

characters.name: Moldir
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Grants +2 Moxie per round to Ultimate carries).
characters.summary: Tactical Ultimate battery and sub-DPS who supercharges Igor and Recoleta rotations.

characters.name: Sentinel
characters.summary: Bridges Bloodtithe and Bullet mechanics, firing crimson counter-shots every time the team's HP fluctuates.

characters.name: Narcissus
characters.summary: Reflects enemy debuffs and grants +35% Ultimate Might & burst healing whenever an ally casts an Ultimate.

characters.name: Vila
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E1 Rank IV (Rusalka state never expires + teamwideEureka/Moxie).
characters.summary: AP-generous Mental & Crit healer whose E1 Euphoria keeps Song of Passion active permanently.

characters.name: Matilda
characters.euphoriaPriority: Euphoria E2 Rank IV (Best budget Impromptu Crit support in the game!).
characters.summary: The Genius Monitor shines at Euphoria E2, granting the entire Impromptu Quartet guaranteed Critical Strikes and huge Crit DMG.

teamTierData.name: Lingering Glow Prismatic Engine
teamTierData.rotation: Marsha and Isolde [E1] rapidly stack Burn & Lingering Glow on all enemies. Lorentz Butterfly rewrites Beryl's incantations to Rank 2/3 and raises the Glow cap, allowing Beryl to detonate multi-million prismatic beams.

teamTierData.name: Dynamo Electric Array ('Dynamo Wheelchair')
teamTierData.rotation: Charon & Enigma accelerate the Pulsing Electric Field straight to Level 3 while granting +1 AP and card shuffles. Ulrich's turrets and Brume's electromagnetic sweeps trigger automatically every turn.

teamTierData.name: Conduit Resonance Core
teamTierData.rotation: Hedone and Everecho link enemies and allies into a Conduit network. Rhiannon grants The Twins an Extra Turn burst window, causing every single-target strike to echo twice across linked bosses.

teamTierData.name: Bloodtithe Crimson Domain
teamTierData.rotation: Place Rubuska in Slot 4. Semmelweis [E1] opens the Blood Domain to drain allied HP into the Bloodtithe Pool while Sentinel fires counter-volleys, setting up Nautika [E1] for massive HP-scaling finishers.

teamTierData.name: Impromptu Inspiration Quartet
teamTierData.rotation: Paper Heron deploys her Eureka Array while Kiperina shields the crew. Matilda [E2] guarantees every end-of-round Impromptu musical barrage conducted by Barcarola critically strikes.

teamTierData.name: Bullet & Ultimate Artillery
teamTierData.rotation: Lopera [E1] maintains permanent Crucible Bullets while Moldir [E1] and Narcissus feed endless Moxie and Ultimate Might into Igor's zero-AP artillery Ultimates.

pullBanners.title: Everecho (6★ Spirit) & Cornerstone
pullBanners.verdict: If you run The Twins or Coppélia, Everecho is the dedicated Slot-4 sustainer that completes the T0 Conduit Core. Safe to stop at Portray 0 (P0).

pullBanners.title: Hedone (6★ Mineral) & Narcissus (6★ Plant)
pullBanners.verdict: Hedone solves single-target boss encounters for Conduit teams by inflicting artificial Conduit echo nodes. Narcissus is the premier healer/buffer for Igor and Recoleta Ultimate teams.

pullBanners.title: Beryl • Brume • Lorentz Butterfly • Charon • Rhiannon
pullBanners.verdict: New and returning Timekeepers should prioritize assembling either the Lingering Glow engine (Beryl + Lorentz Butterfly + Marsha) or the Dynamo Wheelchair (Brume + Charon + Enigma).

pullBanners.patch: Ripples on the Water (Euphoria Custom Banner)
pullBanners.title: Isolde [E1] • Semmelweis [E1] • Nautika [E1] • Lopera [E1]
pullBanners.verdict: Unlike dual 'Yearning of the Water' banners (which should be avoided), the Euphoria 'Ripples on the Water' banner guarantees your selected 6★ on the first 6★ pull! Pick Isolde (for Glow) or Semmelweis (for Bloodtithe).

reveries.title: Reveries in the Rain — Permanent Endgame (Hadal & Wailing Whirl)
reveries.reward: Keys of Thought, Sprouts of Fantasy, Seeds of Inspiration & Clear Drops
tips: Depths of Myth spans Euphotic (10m–100m), Mesopelagic (110m–200m), Bathypelagic (210m–300m), Abyssal (310m–400m), Hadal (410m–500m), and Wailing Whirl (600m–1000m).
Transition Zones require 3 to 4 fully built, non-overlapping teams! Level your Myth Manifests in 'Isle of Echoes' to Level 30 before attempting 400m+.
Never let your weekly Trance cap hit 8/8! Every Monday at 05:00 server time you receive +4 Trance to sweep for Euphoria materials.

bosses.recommended: Team 1: Lingering Glow (Beryl) • Team 2: Dynamo (Brume) • Team 3: Conduit or Bloodtithe
bosses.mechanic: High-depth bosses gain 'Abyssal Hardening' against off-archetype chip damage. Pair your Myth Manifest's active skill with your Carry's burst turn to break their poise gauge.
Equipment (Psychubes) and characters are locked per stage. Spread your 3 strongest sustains (Marsha, Enigma, Everecho/Rubuska) across the 3 nodes.

manes.title: Mane's Bulletin — SSS+ Boss Raids (30-Turn Endurance)
manes.reward: Gluttony (6★ Psychube Amplifier), Crystal Caskets, Sonorous Knells & Polarizers
tips: With 3.x powerhouses, hitting 1,500,000+ (Red SSS+) takes only 12–15 turns if you match the boss's favored mechanic.
Save burst Ultimates and Rhiannon Extra Turns for the phase-break stun window when the boss takes +50% amplified damage.
Always buy the monthly Gluttony and Crystal Casket from the Mane's Bulletin exchange first.

bosses.recommended: Lingering Glow Engine (Beryl, Lorentz Butterfly, Isolde E1, Marsha)
bosses.mechanic: Absorbs direct Physical hits, but takes +120% increased damage from Lingering Glow and Halo detonations. Beryl melts each health bar in 2 turns.

bosses.recommended: Dynamo Wheelchair (Brume, Charon, Ulrich, Enigma) or Bloodtithe
bosses.mechanic: Discharges paralyzing static every 3 rounds. Enigma's Bastion cleanses the paralysis while Brume & Ulrich siphon its charge to stay at Electric Field Lv. 3.

dusk.title: A Series of Dusks — Roguelike Expansion
dusk.reward: Free 6★/5★ Garments, Wilderness Monuments, Gluttony & Clear Drops
tips: Choose the 'Harmonic Catalyst' or 'Catalyst of Artefacts' horn at the start of high-difficulty Delirium runs.
Collect 'Acoustica' relics for your main carry—Acoustica artefacts grant special rule-breaking passives to specific 6★ Arcanists.
If you lack a 3.x unit, use the 'Assist Recruitment' nodes on Floor 1 to borrow a max-portray Beryl or Brume!

bosses.recommended: Dynamo or Lingering Glow + Medication/Dagger Artefact Synergies
bosses.mechanic: Strips buffs from Slot 1 at the start of Phase 2. Place your primary carry in Slot 2 or carry a 'Silver Pendant' artefact for permanent Immunity.

bosses.recommended: Bloodtithe (Nautika E1 + Semmelweis E1) + Vitality Relics
bosses.mechanic: Scales damage with your max HP artefacts; Bloodtithe teams reach 40,000+ HP in Dusk runs and one-shot the boss.

limbo.title: Artificial Somnambulism / Lucidscape (Bi-Weekly Clear Drops)
limbo.reward: 600+ Clear Drops & Oneiric Fluid every 1st and 16th of the month
tips: Use the Express Clear feature to skip straight to the final stages if you 3-starred the previous cycle.
Clear within 12 rounds on both halves for full stars; AoE engines like Dynamo (Brume/Lucy) and Conduit (The Twins) clear most waves in 2–3 rounds.
Spend your Oneiric Fluid in the Somnambulism shop on Sinister Shadows and Thoughts in Entirety.

bosses.recommended: Conduit Core (The Twins, Coppélia, Hedone, Everecho)
bosses.mechanic: Two linked bosses revive each other unless defeated on the same round. Conduit splash damage guarantees both HP bars drop simultaneously.
High Reality DEF shield; bypass with Mental/Genesis damage or multi-hit Impromptu Inspiration barrages.

homeManesBulletinBosses.name: Refracted Sun-Eater
homeManesBulletinBosses.weakness: Takes +120% amplified damage from Lingering Glow beams and loses 15% Mental DEF per Halo stack.
homeManesBulletinBosses.dangerMechanic: Solar Carapace absorbs direct Physical chip hits until broken by 5+ stacks of Burn or Lingering Glow.

homeManesBulletinBosses.name: Overloaded Automaton Core
homeManesBulletinBosses.weakness: Pulsing Electric Field Lv. 3 siphons the boss's static barrier and stuns its auxiliary turrets for 2 rounds.
homeManesBulletinBosses.dangerMechanic: Inflicts AoE Paralyzing Static every 3 turns; bring a cleanser or Bastion shielder to negate control.

homeManesBulletinBosses.name: The Crimson Sovereign
homeManesBulletinBosses.weakness: Entering the phase-break window multiplies HP-sacrifice Bloodtithe finishers and Conduit echo splashes by 1.8x.
homeManesBulletinBosses.dangerMechanic: Applies Bleed & Max HP corrosion to Slot 1; counter with Slot-4 Rubuska or Everecho's teamwide link heal.
